### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **32** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/translations/index.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**46** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de`.

⛔ **14** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/translations/index.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `isSystem (5 routes)`
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `created_at (literal, 38 pages)`
- **12** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **150** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `298ac2fc32c150b9c42a0fbd1a40b5191c1ce8f6` — the merge of head `356172a1f9912baa0c8a1a0a92f77ba9c5b0a557` into base `05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 298ac2fc32c150b9c42a0fbd1a40b5191c1ce8f6 && git checkout 298ac2fc32c150b9c42a0fbd1a40b5191c1ce8f6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de 356172a1f9912baa0c8a1a0a92f77ba9c5b0a557 && git checkout -B drift-repro 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de && git merge --no-ff 356172a1f9912baa0c8a1a0a92f77ba9c5b0a557

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 05b28c199b7408da7ca4bc3988635fa9342cd6de` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `356172a1f9912baa0c8a1a0a92f77ba9c5b0a557`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sys-notification-subscription-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts, docs/adr/0030-notification-platform-convergence.md + packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sys-view-definition-retired.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.scim-provider-object-retired.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/index.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/plugin-declares-event-object.test.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.test.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-plan.integration.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts, .changeset/24923-sys-notification-subscription-retired.md, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-18.0.0/manifest.json

Inputs read: card #24923 body and its five comments (6294724028, 6301928267, 6302614923, 6303388568, 6305755241); parent #24770 decision 6290342354 and recording 6293376907; standing ruling #6015 comment 6292005854; the PR body and file list; the three-dot diff `origin/main...356172a1f9` (41 files, +264/-544) fetched by explicit sha; the head's check-runs. Not the dispatch order, not the seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The retirement is complete on the declared surface.** The object file and its organization-unique pin test are deleted; `NotificationSubscription` leaves `src/index.ts`, `src/objects/index.ts` and the i18n extract config; `messaging-service-plugin.ts` drops it from the import, the manifest `objects`, the Configuration-group nav (`nav_notification_subscriptions`) and the boot-provisioning list; the seven generated bundles lose exactly the `sys_notification_subscription` keys (zh-CN source hashes lose 2, es/ja lose 12, consistent with zh-CN being the authoring locale for the other keys); `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['service-messaging']` shrinks to six names with a bidirectional pin (`isPlatformProvidedObjectName` false, `hasPlatformObjectPrefix` true, preference as control); the `object.zod.ts` doc comment and the tenancy census (85 to 84) follow. Residual mentions at the head outside tests, generated files and docs are exactly four, all intentional: the plugin comment, the CLI inventory row and its header, and the registry rationale fragment. `content/docs` names the object nowhere outside `releases/` (read-only). objectui at the pinned console sha `cf153eb2e5` (the pin main carries) has zero hits for the symbol, the object name and the nav id, against two files for the control word, so the Console Pin Gate is not put at risk.
- **ADR-0087 entry shape is the precedents' shape, correctly.** `18.sys-view-definition-retired.ts` and `18.scim-provider-object-retired.ts` are both platform-object retirements with no `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` entry and no D2 conversion, because no authorable spec key moves and nothing in authored metadata is rewritten. This entry copies that reasoning in its header comment and its four fields; `surface` carries no backticks (the upgrade-guide renderer constraint the view-definition entry documents); `acceptanceCriteria` contains the phrase `left in place untouched`, which the new CLI unit pin reads as the licence for fate 4. "No D2 / no retired-key entry" is right for an object retirement: the only conversion an object retirement could carry would rewrite a stack that names the object, and the entry (like both precedents) tells the author to remove the reference instead.
- **Table left in place** matches ruling D's 裁后执行 ("ADR-0087 语义条目退役对象(表保留)") and the two precedents; the changeset and entry both say no backfill, no reaper, no migrate command, and name the operator's by-hand DROP.
- **CLI inventory fate-4 row.** Census `P1_ONLY` (`platform-census-2026-08-31`) is right: the first census counted the object, so `retired-before-census` would be false; the dev correctly did not reuse the `sys_scim_provider` population and instead added `RETIRED_AFTER_FIRST_CENSUS` with the same premises (counted, no longer registered, entry exists, citation carries no tracker number, `notNullExempt` present). The integration pin builds the table in its last declared shape, plans under `isolated` and `single`, asserts the NULL row is reported and never attributed (`notNull.willReceive` false) and carries a control leg (without the row the plan refuses `uninventoried-platform-table`). The `inventoryDigest` change and the `plan-digest-mismatch` consequence are stated in the changeset.
- **ADR-0030 amendment (Tier H)** is in the same form as the 2026-09-20 amendment: a dated status-line entry naming the ruling and record, the L3 row revised to preference-only with a strike-through of the expansion, and the remaining-work bullet struck and marked Withdrawn. It makes the PR Tier H; it stays a draft with no approving review on the head as of this reading, which is the correct state.
- **Zero-reader measurement is adequate for this repo and the console; cloud is honestly NOT MEASURED.** The PR re-measured on `e4d604efd3` with a control word (preference: 8 files, 2 readers), named each of the 6 hits and classified none as a row reader; the deleted object's own docblock said the expansion was not wired. The decision record 6290342354 already listed cloud as a 置信缺口 and the maintainer ruled D with that gap known, so the gap is not new to this PR. The entry's `reason` claims this repo and the Studio repo only. Acceptable.
- **Leaving the dogfood fixtures unchanged is correct.** `fixture-18.0` and `fixture-18.0.0` are dumps of databases written by released code; `manifest.json` records `sys_notification_subscription: 0` in the counts, and the table is not among `RESHAPED_TABLES`, so no harness assertion reads it. A database an earlier release provisioned holding the table with no reader is precisely the state the entry describes. Both precedents predate the fixtures, so there was no fixture edit to mirror.
- **Public export removed that a consumer imports:** `NotificationSubscription` from `@objectstack/service-messaging` (root and objects barrel) and the name in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`. No in-repo importer remains; objectui at the pin has none; the changeset's FROM to TO names the import removal and the metadata-reference removal.

### ② Semver level

- `minor` for service-messaging, spec and cli, `patch` for platform-objects, with the BREAKING banner and `feat(...)!:` title: consistent with the launch-window convention `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` states (a breaking change ships as `minor`, never `major`). The platform-objects `patch` is for seven deleted hand-written nav label lines; the level axis is satisfied by the three `minor` packages whose `src/**` move.
- ADR-0087 disposition: exactly one marker, `registered sys-notification-subscription-retired`, and the id resolves to the new entry in this diff. Correct category for an entry this PR adds.
- FROM to TO is present for every removed thing an author or consumer could hold: the import, the nav item, the registry name (with the metadata-reference fix), and the CLI plan re-run.
- **Clause-② spelling.** The changeset, PR body and claim all read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. By `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` the four readings are: `yes` or `yes (widening)` a widening; `yes (narrowing)` "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another"; `no (narrowing)` "not a widening, but breaking". This diff widens nothing an author can write or a consumer can import: it is a pure removal plus a registry entry, which is exactly the shape of the nearest precedent #22374 (`sys-view-definition-retired`), whose changeset reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The honest spelling is therefore `no (narrowing)`. The gates accept the line as written: the no-major gate's level axis asks only that a `yes` PR grade at least one moved package `minor` or above (true), and the ADR-0087 gate reads breaking-ness from the `(narrowing)` arm, not from the value, so the disposition requirement fires either way. Fleet practice on merged pure retirements is split (#24721, #24442, #24045, #24970 wrote `yes (narrowing)`; #22374 and 400-plus others wrote `no (narrowing)`), so this is a declaration over-reporting a widening, with no gate or release consequence. Flagged, not failing.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Check-runs on the head:** all 42 completed: 35 success and 7 skipped by filter, 0 red. That includes Test Core 1/6 through 6/6, so the platform-objects suite is green in CI, and Type Check · workspace.
- **Platform-objects tests NOT MEASURED locally** (verify-lock timeouts); the diff there is seven deleted lines across four hand-written dictionaries and three hash maps, removed symmetrically, so `app-nav-translation-parity.test.ts` should hold. Must be green in CI Test Core.
- **Deviation 1, platform-objects translations outside the claimed surface:** the claim listed service-messaging's generated translations, not `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*`. The removed label belongs to the nav item this PR deletes, no other open claim holds those files, the PR body declares it, and `check:i18n` ran green. Accepted as the same retirement's translation half.
- **Deviation 2, dogfood fixtures unchanged:** the dispatch premise ("update the fixtures as the precedents did") was false, as the dev shows; the harness `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` was run locally (12 passed) and the CI job for it is opt-in and skipped on this head, so that evidence is local only. The pin at line 335 ("HEAD's schema plan holds no destructive change") is the one that could have bitten; the precedent's measured behaviour (schema sync is additive, reconciles declared objects only) and the local run both say it does not.
- **`registry.ts.template` overlap with #24970:** #24970 merged at `fde7456352`, which is an ancestor of this head (the head is a merge of `origin/main`). `git merge-tree origin/main 356172a1f9` against current main `73432299c0` is clean, and the API reports mergeable. The new fragment sits at its sorted id position with `order: 106`; the template already carries two other `order: 106` fragments, and no test or build script asserts unique orders, so the equal order is rendered in id order as the dev states.
- **Tier H:** the ADR-0030 edit keeps the whole PR Tier H. This record is the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER half; landing still needs the maintainer's approving review, and no seat arms or queues it.
- **Cloud readers NOT MEASURED** (carried from the decision record's own 置信缺口); the entry scopes its census claim to this repo and the Studio repo.
- Historical mentions (superseded ADR-0012 draft, ADR-0103, `docs/design/`, `docs/handoff/`) are left as written; execution card ② (templates narrow) on #24770 is untouched, as the card intends.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24923-retire-notification-subscription`
Reviewed-by: `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`

**VERDICT: PASS**
